command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$base='http://127.0.0.1:18085'
$track='trk_1ec63e30d6e047eca4d72f4cb72a3f45'
$before=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/v1/favorites?limit=200" -TimeoutSec 5
$had=@($before.items|Where-Object{$_.track_id -eq $track}).Count -gt 0
$delete=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$base/api/v1/favorites/tracks/$track" -Method Delete -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing
$after=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/api/v1/favorites?limit=200" -TimeoutSec 5
$has=@($after.items|Where-Object{$_.track_id -eq $track}).Count -gt 0
if($has){throw 'Browser fixture favorite is still present after reset.'}
[ordered]@{previously_favorited=$had;favorite_cleared=$true;delete_status=[int]$delete.StatusCode}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
